title: HtmlH2
responsibility: Renders the native h2 element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlH2.attributes
inputs.description: Native h2 attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlH2.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native h2 element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlH2
outputs.description: The actual native h2 element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
